title: Piper — Rat Audit Boston demo
notes: Production concept with unfinished features: use docs/submission/demo-script.md for the current-build recording path. Do not present approval, work orders, assistant, or trial design as shipped. Existing video exports need re-rendering after claim corrections. Starting values for this production. Times in seconds of edited video. Camera framing names a target; measure coordinates in rehearsal and add them as camera.*.box = [x, y, w, h] in source pixels. 'vo' lines carry their own start time; voiceover is a separate track from shots.

sources.app: https://rat-ops.vercel.app (or pnpm dev in web/, bound to 127.0.0.1)
